objective: Compare the combined return rate with the equally weighted group average, and explain why these records cannot identify a cause.

inputs.text: This fictional tool library report first describes Cedar depot. Cedar depot issued forty tools; sixteen tools were returned by closing. It next describes Willow depot. Willow depot issued sixty tools; thirty-six tools were returned by closing.
For both depots, a return means the issued tool was checked back in by closing on the same reporting day. No issued tool belongs to both depot groups.
The records contain counts only. They do not measure travel distance or loan duration, so they cannot explain the cause of the difference in return rates.

objective: 比较合并归还率与两个站点归还率的等权平均，并解释这些记录为什么不能支持因果结论。

inputs.text: 这份虚构借用报告先介绍松林站。松林站借出二十件器材，其中十五件在闭馆前归还。随后介绍海湾站。海湾站借出四十件器材，其中十件在闭馆前归还。
两站都将“归还”定义为同一报告日闭馆前完成归还登记。每件借出的器材只属于一个站点，不存在跨站重复。
记录仅有数量，没有记录借用时长或借用者的出行距离，因此不能解释两站归还率差异的原因。

objective: Determine the possible fraction of registered members who attended at least one event; construct both extreme cases and explain why adding attendance counts may overcount.

inputs.text: The fictional Meadow History Society has seventy registered members. The membership list stayed unchanged, and both events used this same registered population.

The first event was archive mapping, attended by forty-four distinct members. The second event was oral history practice, attended by thirty-eight distinct members. Within each attendance list, every person is counted once.
The number of members attending both events was not recorded, and the two attendance lists have not been matched.

objective: 求至少参加一次活动的登记成员比例的可能范围，构造上下界，并说明直接相加为什么可能重复计数。

inputs.text: 虚构青岚自然社共有六十名登记成员。成员名册在两次活动期间保持不变，两次活动均使用这一登记总体。
先举行的活动是河岸观察，有二十八名不同成员参加。第二次活动是树叶分类，有二十五名不同成员参加。每份签到表内部每个人只计一次。
两次活动之间的重复成员人数未记录，两份签到表尚未核对。
